arxiv-2103-11983.title: Extraction of the Muon Signals Recorded with the Surface Detector of the Pierre Auger Observatory Using Recurrent Neural Networks
arxiv-2103-11983.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . The Pierre Auger Observatory, at present the largest cosmic-ray observatory ever built, is instrumented with a ground array of 1600 water-Cherenkov detectors, known as the Surface Detector (SD). The SD samples the secondary particle content (mostly photons, electrons, positrons and muons) of extensive air showers initiated by cosmic rays with energies ranging from 10 17 10^{17}~ eV up to more than 10 20 10^{20}~ eV.

arxiv-2107-12601.title: Microphone Array Generalization for Multichannel Narrowband Deep Speech Enhancement
arxiv-2107-12601.creator: Siyuan Zhang, Xiaofei Li
arxiv-2107-12601.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Siyuan Zhang, Xiaofei Li. This paper addresses the problem of microphone array generalization for deep-learning-based end-to-end multichannel speech enhancement. We aim to train a unique deep neural network (DNN) potentially performing well on unseen microphone arrays. The microphone array geometry shapes the network’s parameters when training on a fixed microphone array, and thus restricts the generalization of the trained network to another microphone array. To resolve this problem, a single network is trained using data recorded by various microphone arrays of different geometries.

arxiv-2307-00374.description: Abstract Knowing exactly how many data points need to be labeled to achieve a certain model performance is a hugely beneficial step towards reducing the overall budgets for annotation. It pertains to both active learning and traditional data annotation, and is particularly beneficial for low resource scenarios. Nevertheless, it remains a largely under-explored area of research in NLP.

pmc-13376236.description: BackgroundChildren born preterm with chronic lung disease of Immaturity (CLDI) frequently present with obstructive lung function, yet optimal bronchodilator therapy remains uncertain. pmc-13552391.title: Dietary, Lifestyle, and Psychological Factors Associated with Premenstrual Syndrome Among Female University Students in Saudi Arabia: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13552391.creator: Mashael Huwaikem
pmc-13552391.description: BackgroundPremenstrual syndrome (PMS) is common among women of reproductive age and has been associated with dietary, lifestyle, anthropometric, and psychological factors. However, evidence regarding the combined associations of these factors with PMS among young women in Saudi Arabia remains limited. This study examined dietary, lifestyle, anthropometric, psychological, and sleep-related factors associated with PMS among female university students.

uslaw-usc-t2-s179l.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 5 (Library Of Congress). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Librarian of Congress (hereafter in sections 179l to 179w of this title referred to as the “Librarian”) shall continue the National Film Registry established and maintained under the National Film Preservation Act of 1988 (Public Law 100–446), and the National Film Preservation Act of.
